The search returned many irrelevant templates; none clearly flavanone cyclisation. Might need different functional groups criteria. Perhaps use "aryl hydroxyls" broken? The forward cyclisation forms ether oxygen and breaks carbonyl (ketone). Could search for functional_groups_formed: ["ether oxygens"], broken: ["ketones"] but got irrelevant. Could try search for "aryl hydroxyls" broken? Or maybe use "aryl hydroxyls" formed? Actually flavanone formation creates a phenolic OH? Not exactly. Might be easier to manually construct route without verifying each template; but need valid template IDs that exist. We have at least sulfonamide template ID 20810. Need other IDs; we can search for bromination: functional_groups_formed: ["halide"], broken: ["aromatic hydrogen"] maybe.
